description: Authoring performance attribution of exact guest text spans. Guest A is the hopeful staying/drawer voice; Guest B is the courteous checking/departure voice. Separators and silent punctuation remain source-offset gaps. This map changes no authored text or game authority.
hash_convention: text_sha256 hashes exact decoded UTF-8 text; source sha256_lf hashes source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF. Offsets are Python Unicode character indexes, end exclusive.
